name: Kangokutou
source:
It was supposed to be just a peaceful field trip. A high school was taking a ferry to school trip, only for it to end tragically as the ship ends up getting hijacked, and only a handful of students were able to escape and survive to an island with no name.

So began the survival of the fittest, as the island was filled with more men than women -- 100 men and only 4 women, including one teacher -- the women did their best to fight against the overwhelming waves of men, proving that they can be better even with lesser forces.

Before long, there was no hope of rescue, so many of the male students started losing their minds and reasoning, starting to act instead on their desire and libido. At the same time, our four heroines have to fight against the hordes of men to whom they are only objects of sexual desire.
translation:
这原本应该只是一趟平静的校外旅行。一所高中的师生乘渡轮参加修学旅行，船只却遭人劫持，行程最终以悲剧收场。只有少数学生成功逃生，漂流到一座无名岛屿。

弱肉强食的生存竞争就此开始。岛上男女比例极端失衡，包括1名教师在内，100名男性中只有4名女性。面对人数占绝对优势、如浪潮般涌来的男人，女性拼尽全力反抗，证明人数更少的一方也能战胜对手。

救援始终杳无音信，许多男学生逐渐丧失理智，只凭欲望与性冲动行事。与此同时，4名女主人公也必须迎战成群的男人——在这些人眼中，她们不过是满足性欲的物品。
